d:
Josh Gates sets out to uncover the truth behind the Ark of the Covenant, one of history’s most elusive religious relics. Following ancient accounts and historical clues, he explores theories about where the Ark might have gone and whether any evidence can reveal its fate.
Could this legendary artefact finally be found, or will its whereabouts remain a mystery?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 3, Episode 12, on Discovery Channel India.
